study.name: Longitudinal immune profiling

methods.did: Participant fixed effects with participant-clustered covariance. The 95% interval comes from the matching fitted model.
methods.paired: Participant fixed effects with participant-clustered covariance. The 95% interval is returned by within_arm_comparison.
methods.cross: Participant-level ordinary least squares. The 95% interval is returned by between_arm_comparison.

study.multiplicity: Benjamini–Hochberg adjustment across four scores for the selected contrast and population.
study.pooled: All annotated cells pools CD8 T cells, B cells, and CD4 T cells.
study.smallSample: Small synthetic cohort. Analytical intervals and p-values are illustrative.
